title: Are Frozen Fruits as Healthy as Fresh?

scenes.text: Frozen fruits are picked at peak ripeness and flash frozen, preserving up to 90% of nutrients
Some frozen fruits, like blueberries, have higher antioxidant levels than fresh due to less handling and damage
